purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official North Horr Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (no third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact involved), then re-cropped at 400/800 DPI around the TOTAL row for digit-level confirmation. The portal only served this PDF after a home-page + set-election session handshake (id=5). North Horr's official Form 34B is a large multi-page scan (the retrieved page itself is printed '12/12' in its own header, i.e. the physical last page of a 12-page constituency polling-station tally); the portal's download endpoint for this form_id returns only 2 of those physical pages (the final TOTAL/signatures page as download page 1, and one mid-document content page, printed '02/12', as download page 2). No cover or intermediate pages were available through this endpoint in this session.

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session, its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values. Constituency identity (NORTH HORR, code 046, county MARSABIT code 010) was read from the page header and cross-checked against the visible 'CON 046' banner marker printed on the TOTAL-row page itself before this row was accepted.

total_valid_votes.note: The TOTAL row's 'Total Valid Votes' cell is printed blank on the official scanned page at up to 800 DPI zoom (not faint or illegible -- genuinely empty). No separate voter-turnout/declaration summary box exists on either of the two pages served by the portal for this form_id. The extraction contract prohibits inferring a result value from the verified candidate-column arithmetic relation, so the candidate-sum identity (23,160 + 3,040 + 29 + 66 = 26,295) is recorded below for transparency only and is not used as the verified value.

rejected_ballots.note: The TOTAL row's 'Rejected Ballots' cell is printed blank on the official scanned page at up to 800 DPI zoom (not faint or illegible -- genuinely empty). No corroborating summary box states this value on either page served for this form_id.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row. Recorded for transparency; not used to infer the blank Total Valid Votes cell per the extraction contract's prohibition on inferring result values from the verified arithmetic relation.

row_reconciliation.governed_p23_registered_voters_source: KDA-VOTERS-CON-046-2022 (data/indicators/registry/observations.json), exact sum of official IEBC child ward rows

note: Registered Voters is clearly legible and reconciles exactly to the governed P23 constituency denominator (36,855 = 36,855). The four candidate cells on the same TOTAL row are also clearly legible. However, the printed TOTAL row itself leaves the 'Total Valid Votes' and 'Rejected Ballots' cells blank, and the two pages served by the portal for this form_id (the constituency's final tally/signatures page and one unrelated mid-document content page) contain no separate declaration or voter-turnout summary box that states either figure independently, unlike some other constituencies' forms (e.g. Kajiado East). Per the extraction contract's prohibition on inferring a result value from the verified candidate-column arithmetic relation, no Total Valid Votes or Rejected Ballots value is recorded as verified. This row remains unresolved and creates no canonical turnout observation.
